editorialNarrative.hook: Geneva opens the final three-event run with fresh crew combinations to settle quickly.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: The eleventh stop of the championship puts the fleet back on Lake Geneva. Kahena Kunze returns to Brazil for the remaining three events, making communication and coordination an immediate storyline. Saturday establishes the event position from which teams must attack Sunday; clean early races matter when the season has so little room left.

editorialNarrative.synopsis: Sunday closes the Switzerland event before the championship's final two rounds. Brazil's returning double Olympic champion Kahena Kunze is one crew change to watch as the fleet converts Saturday's work into an event finish. The sporting question is who leaves Geneva with momentum for the final stretch, rather than merely one fast race.
